title: Behold, a Host, Arrayed in White
description: Behold, a Host, Arrayed in White in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Hans Adolf Brorson, first published in 1760. The tune, DEN STORE HVIDE FLOK, is Traditional Norwegian. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.

lines: Behold a host, arrayed in white,
Like thousand snow clad mountains bright,
Lo, these are they of glorious fame
Who from the great affliction came
Are cleansed from guilt and blame.
Now gathered in the holy place
Their voices they in worship raise,
Despised and scorned, they sojourned here;
But now, how glorious they appear!
So oft, in troubled days gone by,
In anguish they would weep and sigh.
For aye their tears shall dry.
They now enjoy their Sabbath rest,
The paschal banquet of the blest;
Then hail, ye mighty legions, yea,
All hail! Now safe and blest for aye,
Ye did the joys of earth disdain,
Ye toiled and sowed in tears and pain.
Swing high your palms, lift up your song,
Yea, make it myriad voices strong.
